name: Airplane Flying Over Head AI Trend: A Jet Right Above You
blurb: The airplane flying over head AI trend turns one photo into a short clip where a huge airliner glides so low over you that its belly, engines and wheels fill the sky, while you sit at an airport viewing deck at sunset and wave up at it.

prompts.label: 1. Open [AI Photo with this template](https://www.makeviral.ai/photo?template=ai-plane-over-head-trend) and add your photo (your photo). The photo prompt is filled in
prompts.text: Use the uploaded image as the base. Keep the person's face, facial features, skin tone, hair, age, body shape and clothes exactly the same as in the photo. 9:16 vertical travel portrait. Character from reference image sits on guardrail at airport viewing platform, smiling in profile and waving one hand up. Low wide-angle shot with a low-flying airliner overhead. Warm golden dusk rim light, strong perspective, 8K realistic photo with film texture. Exactly one person. The airliner is plain white with no airline name, no logo, no tail emblem, no lettering and no registration number. No other people, no text, no logos, no watermark.

prompts.label: 3. Press the film button on the still to open AI Video with the still as the first frame. Settings: Kling 3.0, 8 s, 1080p, 9:16, sound on. The video prompt
prompts.text: One continuous shot from a low wide angle, like a real phone video at an airport viewing platform at golden dusk. Keep the person's face, hair and clothes and the airliner exactly as in the image. The person sits on the guardrail, smiling in profile, with one hand waving up at the sky. The low-flying airliner glides straight over their head, so low that its huge belly, engines, wheels and landing lights fill the top of the frame, then it flies on and out of the top of the frame. The wind from the jet blows through their hair and clothes; they look up with a big, amazed smile and reach one hand up as if to touch it. The camera stays low and almost still, tilting up a little to follow the plane. Audio: a deep, rising jet engine roar that peaks as the plane passes overhead, rushing wind and the person's surprised laugh; no music, no dialogue. Exactly one person and one airliner. No cuts, no second plane, no extra people, no extra limbs, no morphing. No airline names, no logos, no lettering or registration on the plane, no text, no subtitles.
